View and list strategic plans. Create/update/delete via object
create/update/delete.



Available subcommands:

- show: Display a strategic plan by ID or the first plan (e.g. STRAT-PLAN-001)

- list: List strategic_plan objects with optional filters

  Show primary strategic plan
  zqk.test object splan show
  Show plan by ID
  zqk.test object splan show STRAT-PLAN-001
  List all strategic plans
  zqk.test object splan list

Usage:
  zqk.test object splan [command]

Available Commands:
  list        List strategic plans
  show        Show a strategic plan by ID or the first plan

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)

Use "zqk.test object splan [command] --help" for more information about a command.
